typography.description: Inherit existing header fonts. Use crisp, clear weights for the 'TR' and 'EN' labels outside the switch.
typography.labels: TR and EN labels should be uppercase, font-size around 12-14px depending on breakpoint, semi-bold.

colors.track_background: Authentic SVG with preserved country-specific focus and source-colored field. A flag-only pseudo overlay adds0.35px blur, low-alpha white sheen and subtle inset depth; never obscure symbols or change their focus.
colors.knob_background: Fully opaque neutral#ececec base and silver-white opaque gradient with glossy highlights. No flag tint/transmission; latest user explicitly forbids translucency.

visual enhancers.glassmorphism: OPAQUE opal/frosted glass appearance using neutral highlight layers and subtle depth. backdrop-filter:none; the flag must not be visible through the knob. No red tint.
visual enhancers.depth: Add subtle inner shadows to the track to make it feel recessed, and drop-shadow + inner highlight to the circular knob to make it pop out.
visual enhancers.prohibited: No flat white, no green tones, no rounded-rect knob.

grids: Not strictly applicable. Use flexbox for the inline component layout.

layouts.overall: TR left, existing oval switch center, EN right; unchanged geometry. Desktop order enquiry -> phone/message -> language. ONLY header language control exists; no side-menu switch at any viewport. Mobile/tablet drawer<=1100px hides the header control while open and restores on close. Light page/header themes use soft beige neumorphism; dark defaults retain approved glass. Same-language index defines navbar/footer CONTENT only; never copy its palette/layout to other pages.
layouts.track: Horizontal oval rail, compact, with relative positioning.
layouts.flags: Use original SVG aspect ratios; derive country-specific placement from artwork coordinates so TR crescent/star and UK central cross are fully visible in the exposed side. Exact source-color field remains continuous beneath opaque knob. Stationary during dragging.
layouts.knob: Absolute positioned, perfectly circular (.lang-knob). Moves along the track using CSS transform.
layouts.sizing: Rails remain48x26 / narrowtablet32x20. Knobs now24x24 /18x18, equal1px edge gaps,22px/12px travel. External labels and header geometry unchanged.

motion.transitions: Use cubic-bezier easing for the knob sliding. Smooth iOS-like snap.
motion.interactions: Knob highlights slightly on hover. Smooth transform X updates during drag.

accessibility.guidelines: Ensure keyboard focus is visible (outline-offset). Use aria-labels on the switch. Provide 'data-testid' for all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='lang-switch-toggle', data-testid='lang-label-tr').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling the sliding transition.

media: Unmodified public-domain Wikimedia Commons SVGs stored locally in media/flags/. See SOURCES.md for original URLs and SHA256. No generated or manually redrawn flags.
instructions_to_main_agent: Keep current DOM geometry: external TR/EN native anchors, center switch with one full-background rail and circular knob. Do not reintroduce flag-window spans.

Dark theme keeps the approved subtle flag pane below opaque knob. Light page-design/page-contact/page-bbl headers and explicit data-header-theme=light use restrained neumorphic shadows and dark readable labels. Keep24px/18px knob,1px gaps and flag focus. Header-only control follows icons; mobile drawer hides it while open. No language selector in the side menu.
Logic Mapping: TR active -> knob LEFT and Turkish flag across entire rail; EN active -> knob RIGHT and UK flag across entire rail. Flag remains continuous beneath knob.
Add a standalone vanilla JS module in /app/frontend/js/script.js (or inline) to handle pointer events (pointerdown, pointermove, pointerup) on the switch.

Gesture logic: On pointerdown, capture starting X. On pointermove, update the knob's transform interactively (knob follows pointer). On pointerup, check if dragged past midpoint. If yes, navigate to the other language's URL. If no, snap back. The navigation should happen ONLY on release.
Ensure existing pages and URL routing are preserved. We are just changing the visual layout and interaction of the switch component.
Test sizes on mobile breakpoints to ensure it fits the existing 88px/56px constraints without overflowing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Latest user explicitly requires opacity: no backdrop blur or transmission of the flag through the knob. Create depth with neutral opaque gradients, highlights and soft shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or surfaces with content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
